data.skills: Battery Systems, Li-ion Batteries, LiPo Batteries, Battery Management System (BMS), Charging Systems, Energy Optimization, Power Management, Battery Protection, Cell Balancing, Thermal Management, Energy Density, Cycle Life Analysis, Power Consumption Analysis, Endurance Optimization, UAV Power Systems, Electrical Measurements, Voltage & Current Analysis, Battery Testing, Dynamic Load Testing, Propulsion Power Analysis, Hot-Swap Battery Systems, Redundancy Systems, MATLAB, Python, Data Analysis, Laboratory Testing, Embedded Power Systems
data.eligibility_information:
Candidates will be considered only if they do not have any active backlogs in any academic year/semester. Candidates with previous backlogs will be considered only if all backlogs have been successfully cleared and passed.

Only candidates with no active backlogs and completed academic qualifications will be eligible for consideration.
data.additional_information:
Work on research and analysis of battery systems, energy optimization, charging architectures, and propulsion power requirements for unmanned aerial platforms.

 DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES 

Research Li-ion and LiPo battery technologies suitable for aerial systems. 
Study battery charging methods, balancing techniques, and protection architectures. 
Analyze battery discharge behavior under varying propulsion and compute loads. 
Evaluate energy density, cycle life, and thermal performance of battery systems. 
Investigate battery hot-swap mechanisms and redundancy architectures. 
Analyze propulsion power consumption and overall system endurance performance. 
Support testing and characterization of battery packs under dynamic load conditions.
Benchmark commercial and emerging battery technologies for UAV applications. 
Assist in defining battery status and health monitoring (BMS) requirements. 
Prepare technical reports related to energy systems and endurance optimization. 

Skills Required
Understanding of electrical and electronic engineering fundamentals. 
Basic knowledge of rechargeable battery technologies and charging concepts. 
Ability to analyze electrical measurements and interpret test observations. 
Understanding of voltage, current, power, and energy calculations. 
Familiarity with laboratory instruments and data collection methods.

 PREFERRED SKILLS 
Exposure to battery management systems and protection mechanisms. 
Familiarity with MATLAB, Python, or spreadsheet-based analysis tools.
data.additional_details:
Please find below the additional important details regarding our Company Clauses & Policies:

1.NDA – Non-Disclosure Agreement
Candidates must not disclose or share any confidential information related to their job role, projects, company operations, or work responsibilities with any external party. This clause will remain applicable for a lifetime.
2.NCC – Non-Compete Clause
Upon joining the company, when you decide to leave the organization in the future, you will not be eligible to join any direct competitor of the company for a period of 3 years post the last working day.
3.Minimum Service Agreement – 2 Years
Candidates from any branch having less than 2 Years of Experience are required to sign a mandatory 2-year Minimum Service Agreement. However, Candidates with more than 2 years of prior experience are exempted from the Minimum Service Agreement. Additionally breach of this agreement will result in a financial penalty of 40% of the CTC.
